locator_training.candidate_static_cache: may be generated from frozen pre-simulation inputs; labels must not enter cache
locator_training.candidate_static_features: frozen graph K3 features + SA0/SA1 one-hot + frozen V1 support vector
locator_training.negative_sampling: deterministic, within DEV_TRAIN; exclude all known same-profile positives in that partition
locator_training.positive_definition: same observable response profile within the active partition

locked_evaluation_after_selection.DEV_SITE_TEST: one evaluation only after model and calibration lock
locked_evaluation_after_selection.HOLDOUT: blocked until a separately frozen authorization
locked_evaluation_after_selection.VALIDATION: historical V1 evidence only; V2 access prohibited

prohibitions: opening DEV_SITE_TEST during fitting or selection
using fault/site/type identity from the query as input
using profile_index or catalog membership as a query feature
treating normal-compatible faults as observable detections
required_metrics: SA0/SA1 accuracy conditional on observable anomaly

selection.profile_overlap_policy: report cross-partition and profile-novel subsets separately; unique-site top1 is mandatory
selection.threshold_selection: NONE FOR EXACT DETECTOR; ranker uncertainty calibration only

DEV_CALIBRATION.use: candidate selection and uncertainty calibration only

training_authorization: AUTHORIZED FOR DEV_TRAIN ONLY AFTER THIS FREEZE PASSES
